# 🤖 ExpenWall AI Agent Suite

Specialized AI agent system prompts for ExpenWall Mobile development.
Paste any agent as a **system prompt** in Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT.

Inspired by [Agency Agents](https://github.com/msitarzewski/agency-agents).

---

## 📋 Available Agents

| Agent | File | When to Use |
|-------|------|-------------|
| 📲 Mobile App Builder | `MOBILE_APP_BUILDER.md` | Flutter features, bug fixes, Firestore |
| 🤖 AI Engineer | `AI_ENGINEER.md` | Receipt OCR, auto-categorization, Gemini insights |
| 🎨 UI Designer | `UI_DESIGNER.md` | Screen design, charts, finance UX |
| 🔒 Security Engineer | `SECURITY_ENGINEER.md` | Financial data security, Firebase rules |

---

## 🔄 Recommended Workflow

```
New Expense Feature
       ↓
🤖 AI Engineer → Design the ML/AI logic
       ↓
📲 Mobile App Builder → Build the Flutter implementation
       ↓
🎨 UI Designer → Make it look premium
       ↓
🔒 Security Engineer → Review financial data handling
```
